_readme: The Society's regular weekly schedule during teaching weeks. TO ADD AN ENTRY: copy one of the objects in 'weekly', change the fields, and save - the homepage strip, events page, printable schedule and the subscribable calendar all regenerate from this file at build time. 'day' is Monday..Sunday. Times are 24-hour local Canberra time. 'category' is one of: mass, confession, adoration, prayer, study, social, formation. Set 'liturgy': true for anything sacramental so it is included in the Mass-and-liturgy-only calendar feed. 'timeNote' is optional: leave it "" for a normal fixed time, or write a short phrase (e.g. 'Time changes weekly') and the site prints that instead of the clock times.
_verification: IMPORTANT: confirm every time below with the chaplain before each semester, then update 'lastVerified'. The site prints this date so visitors know how fresh the information is.
semesterNote: Schedule shown is for ANU teaching weeks in Semester 2, 2026. Times can move in teaching breaks and exam periods - check our Instagram for the current week.

weekly.title: Confession
weekly.location: St John the Evangelist Chapel, 51 Daley Road
weekly.description: The Sacrament of Reconciliation is available for half an hour before Friday Mass, or by asking the chaplain at any Society event.

weekly.title: Eucharistic Adoration
weekly.location: St John the Evangelist Chapel, 51 Daley Road

weekly.title: Holy Mass
weekly.location: St John the Evangelist Chapel, 51 Daley Road
weekly.description: Our weekly Mass on campus - the heart of the Society's week. Everyone is welcome, Catholic or not.

weekly.title: Pizza & Fellowship after Mass
weekly.description: Stay after Friday Mass for pizza in the chaplaincy room and good conversation. The easiest first event to come along to.

weekly.title: Coffee Catch-up
weekly.description: A relaxed mid-week coffee at Badger & Co in Kambri - and the coffee is on us. Drop in between classes; no need to stay the whole time.
